progress_bar() visualizes determinate completion against max_value (default 100) with an accessible role="progressbar". [ {"type": "progress_bar", "label": "Knowledge base indexing", "value": 74, "max_value": 100}, {"type": "progress_bar", "label": "Monthly API quota (312 / 500)", "value": 312, "max_value": 500} ]
Parameter Type Description label str Descriptive caption above the bar. value, max_value number Current value and maximum scale (default 100).
